                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文对TenSeal库的官方Tutorial 1内容进行了翻译，并对其中部分内容做了更为详细介绍，理解该示例后，可初步的掌握全同态库在线性及逻辑回归中的应用！

<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>1 背景介绍</h1>
<p>文章基于TenSEAL开源项目的Tutorial 1内容进行，可以直接打开最后参考1链接查看原文。主要内容是用逻辑回归算法，根据患者的身体数据，预测他未来10年是否有心脏病风险。</p>
<p>预测目标：10 年内患冠心病（CHD）的风险；</p>
<p>输出结果：是（1）或否（0）→ 二分类问题；</p>
<p>使用模型：逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）；</p>
<h2>1.1 数据集</h2>
<p>该数据集可在<a href="https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/dileep070/heart-disease-prediction-using-logistic-regression/data" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Kaggle</a>网站上公开获取，来源于美国马萨诸塞州弗雷明汉镇居民的一项持续进行的心血管研究。研究分类目标是预测患者在未来10年内是否存在冠心病（CHD）风险。数据集包含患者信息，共有4000多条记录和16个属性。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402154840283-973067432.png" alt="image" width="971" height="503" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>（1）<strong>人口统计学（Demographic）</strong><br>性别（Sex）：男性或女性（分类变量）<br>年龄（Age）：患者年龄（连续变量——虽然记录为整数，但年龄本质上是连续的）<br>教育（Education）：教育类型分为4类</p>
<p>（2）<strong>行为因素（Behavioral）</strong><br>当前是否吸烟（Current Smoker）：当前是否为吸烟者（分类变量）<br>每日吸烟量（Cigs Per Day）：每天平均吸烟数量（可视为连续变量，因为可以是任意数量）</p>
<p>（3）<strong>医学史（Medical - history）</strong><br>是否服用降压药（BP Meds）：是否服用降压药（分类变量）<br>是否曾中风（Prevalent Stroke）：是否有中风史（分类变量）<br>是否高血压（Prevalent Hyp）：是否患有高血压（分类变量）<br>是否糖尿病（Diabetes）：是否患有糖尿病（分类变量）</p>
<p>（4）<strong>当前医学指标（Medical - current）</strong><br>总胆固醇（Tot Chol）：连续变量<br>收缩压（Sys BP）：连续变量<br>舒张压（Dia BP）：连续变量<br>体重指数（BMI）：连续变量<br>心率（Heart Rate）：连续变量（虽然本质离散，但通常视为连续变量）<br>血糖（Glucose）：连续变量</p>
<p>（5）<strong>预测变量（目标变量）</strong></p>
<p>10 年冠心病风险（CHD）：二分类变量（1 表示“是”，0 表示“否”）。</p>
<h2>1.2 数据处理</h2>
<p>在原文中提到的P-value（P值）指的是显著性水平，显著性水平是假设检验中的一个概念，是指当原假设为正确时人们却把它拒绝了的概率或风险，这里它用于判断某个特征（如“抽烟”）对结果的影响是否是真实存在的，还是仅仅因为随机巧合。显著性水平是假设检验中的一个概念，是指当原假设为正确时人们却把它拒绝了的概率或风险。它是公认的小概率事件的概率值，必须在每一次统计检验之前确定，通常取α=0.05或α=0.01。在该实例中P值量化了“虚假关联”的风险，即P值&lt;α则认为风险低，要把特征收入预测模型里，P值&gt;α风险高，这个特征可能是“骗子”，可以把它丢弃。文中纸用向后剔除法（Backward Elimination）剔除P值&gt;0.05的特征，最后只保留P值小于0.05的有效特征，如性别：男性患病几率比女性高78.8%，年龄：年龄每增加1岁，风险增加 7%等。&nbsp;</p>
<h1>2 理论基础</h1>
<h2>2.1 线性回归（Linear Regression)</h2>
<h3>1 概念</h3>
<p>首先看下线性、非线性和回归的概念：</p>
<p> 线性：两个变量之间的关系是一次函数关系的——图象是直线，叫做线性。</p>
<p>非线性：两个变量之间的关系不是一次函数关系的——图象不是直线，叫做非线性。</p>
<p>回归：人们在测量事物的时候因为客观条件所限，求得的都是测量值，而不是事物真实的值，为了能够得到真实值，无限次的进行测量，最后通过这些测量数据计算回归到真实值，这就是回归的由来。</p>
<p>所以线性回归就是：用一条直线（或超平面）去拟合数据，通过已知的输入 X，预测一个连续的输出 Y。</p>
<h3>2 解决的问题</h3>
<p>对大量的观测数据进行处理，从而得到比较符合事物内部规律的数学表达式。也就是说寻找到数据与数据之间的规律所在，从而就可以模拟出结果，也就是对结果进行预测。解决的就是通过已知的数据得到未知的结果，例如：对房价的预测、判断信用评价、电影票房预估等。</p>
<h3>3 模型及公式</h3>
<p>最简单的线性回归可以用公式：y = wx + b表示，这里y是预测结果，x是输入特征，w是权重（斜率），b是偏置（截距），这就是一条直线，线性回归的任务就是：找到最好的w和b，让这条直线最贴合数据。</p>
<p>在此基础上扩展到多个特征时，有公式：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402095808659-490250344.png" alt="image" width="465" height="38" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>这时y仍为预测值，x<sub>1</sub>~x<sub>n</sub>是n个特征，w<sub>1</sub>~w<sub>n</sub>是对用的系数（权重），b仍为截距，该公式还可以表示为更简洁的向量形式：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402100845430-532936719.png" alt="image" width="157" height="32" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>此时就可通过损失函数来得到预测的损失，如基于MSE（Mean Squared Error）均方误差：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402113457271-246893852.png" alt="image" width="383" height="52" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>基于RMSE（Root Mean Squared Error）均方根误差：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402113710197-1970045398.png" alt="image" width="402" height="69" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>基于MAE（Mean Absolute Error）平均绝对值误差：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402114105750-737955263.png" alt="image" width="400" height="58" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>以上m是样本数量，y<sub>i</sub>是实际值，^y<sub>i</sub>是预测值，由线性回归公式计算得到，之后即可由梯度下降法，通过对损失函数对各个参数求偏导计算梯度，并沿梯度方向反方向迭代更新参数使得Loss损失最小。</p>
<h2>2.2 逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）</h2>
<p>逻辑回归是一种统计中的回归分析方法，用于根据一组自变量预测分类因变量的结果。逻辑回归主要用于预测，同时也可以用于计算某事件发生的概率。Logistic回归的因变量可以是二分类的，也可以是多分类的，但是二分类的更为常用，也更加容易解释。逻辑回归常用于数据挖掘，疾病自动诊断，经济预测等领域。逻辑回归和线性回归关系密切，简单来说：逻辑回归 = 线性回归 + Sigmoid激活函数，逻辑回归的核心计算部分，本质就是线性回归；只是在输出层套了一层Sigmoid，把线性输出压缩到0~1的概率区间，从而实现二分类。</p>
<p>Sigmoid函数：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402120352376-1414288062.png" alt="image" width="302" height="61" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>其图形如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402120811540-401639054.png" alt="image" width="341" height="230" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>意义是将连续的(-∞, +∞)映射到[0, 1]，这里[0, 1]正好可以对应概率p取值范围，即p=sigmoid(x) = 1/(1+e<sup>-x</sup>)，将之前预测结果表示为logit(p) = W<sup>T</sup>X + b，则有：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260403114345902-1297133072.png" alt="image" width="493" height="76" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>同时可知：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402122449106-1627508408.png" alt="image" width="506" height="69" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>即logit(p)正是线性回归的线性部分，同时它是概率的对数几率，把0~1的概率线性映射到整个实数域，它正是线性模型和概率之间的桥梁。在进行逻辑回归时，不直接预测概率，而是预测概率的logit值，再由logit值通过Sigmoid函数还原概率，完美解决了“线性模型预测概率”的问题。对应到心脏病预测实例，通过以下公式完成预测：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402123758296-717763749.png" alt="image" width="1106" height="73" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>2.3 Sigmoid函数近似表示</h2>
<p>在全同态加密时，不能简单地在加密数据上计算sigmoid，需要使用低次多项式来近似该，而且受限于同态加密乘法运算深度限制，次数越低越好，所以目标是执行尽可能少的乘法，以便能够使用较小的参数，从而优化计算。参考3中的文章给出两个接近Sigmoid函数的近似函数，这里选取在[-5, 5]范围内更接近Sigmoid函数的σ(x) = 0.5 + 0.197x - 0.004x<sup>3</sup>。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402124942082-836595395.png" alt="image" width="1052" height="391" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>2.4 Z-Score标准化</h2>
<p>目的是将不同量纲（单位）的特征——比如“年龄”（20-80岁）和“胆固醇”（150-400mg/dL）——缩放到同一个“起跑线”上，即将特征取值标准化为均值为0、标准差为1的分布，对应的数学公式是：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402160215644-787969450.png" alt="image" width="115" height="49" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>x<sub>i</sub>：特征的取值</p>
<p>μ：特征取值的平均值，特征值减去它能让数据的中心点移动到0；</p>
<p>σ：特征取值的标准差，除以它能让数据的波动范围（缩放比例）变为1；</p>
<p>执行该操作出于以下原因：</p>
<p>（1）梯度爆炸与难以收敛</p>
<p>在训练逻辑回归或神经网络时，如果“胆固醇”数值是 300，而“是否抽烟”是1，模型会给胆固醇分配极小的权重，给抽烟分配极大的权重。这会导致梯度下降时像在“深谷”中反复震荡，很难找到最优解。</p>
<p>（2）特征权重不公平</p>
<p>如果一个特征的数值范围是0-1000，另一个是0-1，模型会下意识地认为数值大的特征更重要。标准化确保了每个特征对预测结果的贡献是基于其变化规律，而不是数值大小。</p>
<h1>3 源码分析</h1>
<h2>3.1 Setup</h2>
<p>程序最一开始需要import所有依赖的相关模块，请确保各模块已经按照到系统中：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tenseal as ts
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> random
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> time <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> those are optional and are not necessary for training</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> matplotlib.pyplot as plt</pre>
</div>
<p>接下来程序会对之前Kaggle网站上下载的程序进行处理，如删除无效数据及无关特征列，并按相同的数量随机采样患病和不患病数据集，这样做的目的是解决类不平衡问题（Class Imbalance）。因为在心脏病预测（Framingham）数据集中，患病（1）的人数远少于未患病（0）的人数，如果不处理，模型会倾向于预测所有人都不患病。程序还提供random_data()函数，该函数生成随机的、线性可分的点，对于那些只想看看事情是如何运作的人来说，可以使用它来代替Kaggle的数据集。这部分程序完整源码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>torch.random.manual_seed(73<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
random.seed(</span>73<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将原始数据进行随机洗牌后，按7:3的比例分割，分别做为训练集和测试集</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> split_train_test(x, y, test_ratio=0.3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    idxs </span>= [i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(len(x))]
    random.shuffle(idxs)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> delimiter between test and train data</span>
    delim = int(len(x) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> test_ratio)
    test_idxs, train_idxs </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> idxs[:delim], idxs[delim:]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x[train_idxs], y[train_idxs], x[test_idxs], y[test_idxs]

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> heart_disease_data():
    data </span>= pd.read_csv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./data/framingham.csv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> drop rows with missing values</span>
    data =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.dropna()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> drop some features</span>
    data = data.drop(columns=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">education</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">currentSmoker</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BPMeds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">diabetes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">diaBP</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BMI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">save cleaned data to data/framingham_cleaned.csv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    data.to_csv(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./data/framingham_cleaned.csv</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, index=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据TenYearCHD（十年内心脏病风险，0或1）这一列，将原始数据集拆分为两个子集</span>
    grouped = data.groupby(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TenYearCHD</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">data = grouped.apply(lambda x: x.sample(grouped.size().min(), random_state=73).reset_index(drop=True))</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 执行分组并采样，使用数量少的那个类别个数进行采样，每个组（0 和 1）都随机抽取等量的样本</span>
    data = grouped.apply(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> x: x.sample(grouped.size().min(), random_state=73), include_groups=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">data.to_csv("./data/twogroupdata1.csv")</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 核心步骤：恢复被排除的分组列</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 因为 include_groups=False 把它变成了索引，我们需要把它变回列，使数据结构回归到普通的表格形式</span>
    data = data.reset_index(level=0).reset_index(drop=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">data.to_csv("./data/twogroupdata2.csv")</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> extract labels</span>
    y = torch.tensor(data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TenYearCHD</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>].values).float().unsqueeze(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 丢弃TenYearCHD列</span>
    data = data.drop(columns=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TenYearCHD</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> standardize data，标准化确保了每个特征对预测结果的贡献是基于其变化规律，而不是数值大小</span>
    data = (data - data.mean()) /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.std()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">data.to_csv("./data/last.csv")</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">print("have save data/last.csv")</span>
    x =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.tensor(data.values).float()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> split_train_test(x, y)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> random_data(m=1024, n=2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> data separable by the line `y = x`</span>
    x_train =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.randn(m, n)
    x_test </span>= torch.randn(m // 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, n)
    y_train </span>= (x_train[:, 0] &gt;= x_train[:, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]).float().unsqueeze(0).t()
    y_test </span>= (x_test[:, 0] &gt;= x_test[:, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]).float().unsqueeze(0).t()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> You can use whatever data you want without modification to the tutorial</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test = random_data()</span>
x_train, y_train, x_test, y_test =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> heart_disease_data()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">############# Data summary #############</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x_train has shape: {x_train.shape}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y_train has shape: {y_train.shape}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x_test has shape: {x_test.shape}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y_test has shape: {y_test.shape}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#######################################</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>程序运行后输出如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402162541137-191330748.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>3.2 训练逻辑回归模型</h2>
<p>将首先训练一个逻辑回归模型（没有任何加密），它可以被视为一个具有单个节点的单层神经网络，后续将使用此模型作为与加密训练和评估进行比较的手段。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LR(torch.nn.Module):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, n_features):
        super(LR, self).</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
        self.lr </span>= torch.nn.Linear(n_features, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> forward(self, x):
        out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.sigmoid(self.lr(x))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> out

n_features </span>= x_train.shape[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LR(n_features)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> use gradient descent with a learning_rate=1</span>
optim = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> use Binary Cross Entropy Loss</span>
criterion =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.nn.BCELoss()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> define the number of epochs for both plain and encrypted training</span>
EPOCHS = 5

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> train(model, optim, criterion, x, y, epochs=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">EPOCHS):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> e <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(1, epochs + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
        optim.zero_grad()
        out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model(x)
        loss </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> criterion(out, y)
        loss.backward()
        optim.step()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Loss at epoch {e}: {loss.data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model

model </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> train(model, optim, criterion, x_train, y_train)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy(model, x, y):
    out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model(x)
    correct </span>= torch.abs(y - out) &lt; 0.5
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> correct.float().mean()

plain_accuracy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy(model, x_test, y_test)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Accuracy on plain test_set: {plain_accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>该段程序输出如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402162512547-213545937.png" alt="image" width="371" height="97" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>正如原文所说，高精度不是该程序的目标，这里只是想看看加密数据的训练不会影响最终结果，所以将比较加密数据的准确性和在这里得到的plain_accuracy。</p>
<h2>3.3 基于明文参数的加密数据评估</h2>
<p>在这一部分中，将只关注在<strong>加密测试集上使用明文参数</strong>（可选加密参数）评估逻辑回归模型。首先创建一个类似PyTorch的LR模型，可以评估加密数据：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncryptedLR:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, torch_lr):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TenSEAL processes lists and not torch tensors,</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> so we take out the parameters from the PyTorch model</span>
        self.weight =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch_lr.lr.weight.data.tolist()[0]
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch_lr.lr.bias.data.tolist()
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> forward(self, enc_x):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> We don't need to perform sigmoid as this model</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> will only be used for evaluation, and the label</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> can be deduced without applying sigmoid</span>
        enc_out = enc_x.dot(self.weight) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.bias
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enc_out
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__call__</span>(self, *args, **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kwargs):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> self.forward(*args, **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kwargs)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">###############################################</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># You can use the functions below to perform ##</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"># the evaluation with an encrypted model     ##</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">###############################################</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypt(self, context):
        self.weight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ts.ckks_vector(context, self.weight)
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ts.ckks_vector(context, self.bias)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decrypt(self, context):
        self.weight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.weight.decrypt()
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.bias.decrypt()

eelr </span>= EncryptedLR(model)</pre>
</div>
<p>之后创建一个TenSEAL Context，用于指定要使用的方案和参数。在这里，选择小而安全的参数，<strong>允许进行一次乘法</strong>。这足以评估逻辑回归模型，之后会发现，在对加密数据进行训练时，会需要更大的参数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> parameters</span>
poly_mod_degree = 4096<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
coeff_mod_bit_sizes </span>= [40, 20, 40<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> create TenSEALContext</span>
ctx_eval = ts.context(ts.SCHEME_TYPE.CKKS, poly_mod_degree, -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, coeff_mod_bit_sizes)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> scale of ciphertext to use</span>
ctx_eval.global_scale = 2 ** 20
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> this key is needed for doing dot-product operations</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ctx_eval.generate_galois_keys()

t_start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
enc_x_test </span>= [ts.ckks_vector(ctx_eval, x.tolist()) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x_test]
t_end </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Encryption of the test-set took {int(t_end - t_start)} seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>在代码中，会在评估前加密测试数据集。接下来在构建EncryptedLR类时，不会在线性层的加密输出上计算sigmoid函数，仅仅是因为它不是必需的，在加密数据上计算sigmic会增加计算时间并需要更大的加密参数，但是，在之后的加密训练中会使用sigmoid。当前，直接进行加密测试集上的评估，并将其准确性与普通测试集进行比较。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted_evaluation(model, enc_x_test, y_test):
    t_start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
    
    correct </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> enc_x, y <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> zip(enc_x_test, y_test):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> encrypted evaluation</span>
        enc_out =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model(enc_x)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> plain comparison</span>
        out =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enc_out.decrypt()
        out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.tensor(out)
        out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.sigmoid(out)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> torch.abs(out - y) &lt; 0.5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            correct </span>+= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    
    t_end </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Evaluated test_set of {len(x_test)} entries in {int(t_end - t_start)} seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Accuracy: {correct}/{len(x_test)} = {correct / len(x_test)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> correct /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> len(x_test)
    

encrypted_accuracy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted_evaluation(eelr, enc_x_test, y_test)
diff_accuracy </span>= plain_accuracy -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted_accuracy
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Difference between plain and encrypted accuracies: {diff_accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> diff_accuracy &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Oh! We got a better accuracy on the encrypted test-set! The noise was on our side...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>程序运行结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402173218962-1122886338.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>不仅比明文直接评估的精度有所下降，而且对比原文章加密评估的精度0.6736526946107785，还要低一些只有0.6167664670658682，这里不知是什么原因。</p>
<h2>3.4&nbsp;基于加密数据训练的加密逻辑回归模型</h2>
<p>在这一部分中，将重新定义一个类似PyTorch的模型，该模型既可以向前传播加密数据，也可以反向传播以更新权重，从而在加密数据上训练加密的逻辑回归模型，以下是关于训练的更多细节。</p>
<h3>1 损失函数</h3>
<p>这里使用带有正则化的二元交叉熵损失函数，y<sup>(i)</sup>是第i个预期标签，^y<sup>(i)</sup>是是逻辑回归模型的第i个输出，θ是n维权重向量，损失函数如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260402181049055-945832879.png" alt="image" width="650" height="66" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>上面公式中m是样本数量，n是特征数量，损失可以分成两部分，前半部分是交叉熵损失：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260403105333814-123947487.png" alt="image" width="453" height="65" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>当真实值y=0和y=1时，以上公式可分别简化为：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260403104653730-371637184.png" alt="image" width="425" height="51" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>以真实值y=0为例，预测^y越接近0，则损失值越小越接近零，反之预测越接近1，损失值越大，同样对于真实值y=1时，有相同的规律，而且通过响应函数的图形也能直观的看到该规律：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260403105129669-161572175.png" alt="image" width="642" height="537" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>公式中的后半部分是正则化项（Regularization）：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260403105414059-1512596794.png" alt="image" width="119" height="61" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>θ<sub>j</sub>：权重向量中的第j个值，λ：正则化系数，该部分意义在于惩罚过大的权重，以保证模型不能过度依赖某一个特征，必须保持权重相对“温和”。</p>
<h3>2 参数更新</h3>
<p>为了进行参数更新，使用如下规则，这里x<sup>(i)</sup>是第i个输入数据：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407102421420-846473421.png" alt="image" width="422" height="67" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>然而，由于同态加密约束，这里使用α=1以减少乘法，并使用λ/m=0.05，从而得出以下更新规则：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407103134534-21366065.png" alt="image" width="366" height="57" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h3>3 同态加密参数</h3>
<p>从输入数据到参数更新，密文需要深度为6的乘法运算，1用于点积运算，2用于sigmoid算法近似计算，3用于反向传播阶段（其中1个隐藏在backward函数中的<span data-slate-fragment="">self._delta_w += enc_x * out_minus_y运算中，该运算将1维度的向量与n维度的向量相乘，需要掩码提取第一个槽位的值并依次复制到n个槽位的其他位置</span>）。对于大约20位的缩放，我们需要6个与缩放具有相同比特大小的系数模数，加上最后一个需要更多比特的系数，我们已经超出了4096个多项式模数（如果我们考虑128位的安全性，这需要系数模数的总比特数&lt;109），所以将使用8192。这将允许我们在单个密文中批量处理多达4096个值。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Training an Encrypted Logistic Regression Model on Encrypted Data</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncryptedLR:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__init__</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(self, torch_lr):
        self.weight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch_lr.lr.weight.data.tolist()[0]
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch_lr.lr.bias.data.tolist()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> we accumulate gradients and counts the number of iterations</span>
        self._delta_w =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        self._delta_b </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        self._count </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> forward(self, enc_x):
        enc_out </span>= enc_x.dot(self.weight) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.bias
        enc_out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncryptedLR.sigmoid(enc_out)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enc_out
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> backward(self, enc_x, enc_out, enc_y):
        out_minus_y </span>= (enc_out -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enc_y)
        self._delta_w </span>+= enc_x *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> out_minus_y
        self._delta_b </span>+=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> out_minus_y
        self._count </span>+= 1
        
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> update_parameters(self):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> self._count ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">raise</span> RuntimeError(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">You should at least run one forward iteration</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> update weights</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> We use a small regularization term to keep the output</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> of the linear layer in the range of the sigmoid approximation</span>
        self.weight -= self._delta_w * (1 / self._count) + self.weight * 0.05<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        self.bias </span>-= self._delta_b * (1 /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self._count)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> reset gradient accumulators and iterations count</span>
        self._delta_w =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        self._delta_b </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
        self._count </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0
    
    @staticmethod
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sigmoid(enc_x):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> We use the polynomial approximation of degree 3</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> sigmoid(x) = 0.5 + 0.197 * x - 0.004 * x^3</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> from https://eprint.iacr.org/2018/462.pdf</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> which fits the function pretty well in the range [-5,5]</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> enc_x.polyval([0.5, 0.197, 0, -0.004<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> plain_accuracy(self, x_test, y_test):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> evaluate accuracy of the model on</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> the plain (x_test, y_test) dataset</span>
        w =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.tensor(self.weight)
        b </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.tensor(self.bias)
        out </span>= torch.sigmoid(x_test.matmul(w) + b).reshape(-1, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        correct </span>= torch.abs(y_test - out) &lt; 0.5
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> correct.float().mean()    
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypt(self, context):
        self.weight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ts.ckks_vector(context, self.weight)
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ts.ckks_vector(context, self.bias)
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> decrypt(self):
        self.weight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.weight.decrypt()
        self.bias </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self.bias.decrypt()
        
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">__call__</span>(self, *args, **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kwargs):
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> self.forward(*args, **<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">kwargs)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> parameters</span>
poly_mod_degree = 8192<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
coeff_mod_bit_sizes </span>= [40, 21, 21, 21, 21, 21, 21, 40<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> create TenSEALContext</span>
ctx_training = ts.context(ts.SCHEME_TYPE.CKKS, poly_mod_degree, -1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, coeff_mod_bit_sizes)
ctx_training.global_scale </span>= 2 ** 21<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
ctx_training.generate_galois_keys()

t_start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
enc_x_train </span>= [ts.ckks_vector(ctx_training, x.tolist()) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x_train]
enc_y_train </span>= [ts.ckks_vector(ctx_training, y.tolist()) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> y <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y_train]
t_end </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Encryption of the training_set took {int(t_end - t_start)} seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>下面结合源码详细分析乘法深度，在代码forward函数中，密文enc_x会和密文self.weight进行点积运算，会消耗第1层深度（Level 1）；接下来调用sigmoid多项式近似计算，x<sup>2</sup>需要一次乘法消耗第2层，计算x<sup>3</sup>会消耗第3层（这里其实是0.004·x<sup>3</sup>，操作过程中会行“常数合并”，在进行系数相乘时，会借用x<sup>3</sup>生成过程中本来就消耗调的层，并不会在系数乘消耗额外的层，所以这里总共消耗2层）；正如原文所述在接下来进行self._delta_w += enc_x * out_minus_y时，除了enc_x*out_minus_y乘法本身会消耗一层外，这里还有一个隐藏操作会额外消耗一层，易知out_minus_y是通过enc_out - enc_y得到的，虽然逻辑上它是一个误差值，但是在TenSEAL的内存布局中，它依然是一个向量，是一个继承自enc_out的Level 3密文，内部构造类似[err, noise<sub>1</sub>, noise<sub>2</sub>, ..., noise<sub>k</sub>]，除了第一个槽位有有效值外，其他本是“空”的槽位上充满了不可控的随机噪声，如果直接进行“旋转并累加”完成enc_x*out_minus_y操作，会把后面槽位上的噪声也一起叠加进来，所以TenSEAL中先执行了out_minus_y*[1, 0, 0, ...]，即掩码操作最终产生[err, 0, 0, ...]，清空了其他位置的干扰，正是这里的乘法操作导致Scale变大，为了接下来的“旋转累加”操作，这里密文的Scale必须出于标准状态（通常是global_scale），所以这里会执行一次rescale从而消耗了1层深度，接下来即可正常进行旋转与加法，如将out_minus_y向右旋转1位得到y_rot1 = [0, err, 0, 0, ...]，y = y + y_rot1得到y = [err, err, 0, 0, ...]，继续旋转加最终得到y = [err, err, err, ...]，之后即可真正的执行enc_x * out_minus_y操作，所以这里总共消耗2层深度，此时共消耗5层深度；接下来循环完成后的update_parameters函数调用中，self.weight -= self._delta_w * (1 / self._count) + self.weight * 0.05操作中的乘法还会消耗1层深度，所以最终需要的乘法深度是6。运行结果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407154442109-1057957606.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>接下来研究在明文域和加密域内x.dot(weight) + bias的分布，确保它们落在[-5, 5]区间内，这正是sigmoid近似比较准确的位置，我们不希望给它提供超出此范围的数据，这样就不会得到错误的输出，错误的输出会使得我们的训练不可预测。但是权重会在训练过程中发生变化，我们应该在学习的同时尽量保持它们尽可能小。有一种经常用于逻辑回归的技术，正是这样做的（但服务于另一个目的，即泛化），被称为正则化，你可能已经在update_parameters函数中发现了附加项self.weight*0.05，这是正则化的结果。简而言之，由于我们的sigmoid近似仅在[-5, 5]范围内有效，我们希望它的所有输入都在这个范围内，为了做到这一点，需要保持逻辑回归参数尽可能小，因此我们应用正则化。</p>
<p>注意：保持参数较小肯定会降低输出的幅度，但如果数据没有标准化，我们也可能超出范围。你可能已经发现，我们将数据标准化为均值为0，标准差为1，这既是为了提高性能，也是为了将sigmoid的输入保持在所需的范围内。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>normal_dist = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">lambda</span> x, mean, var: np.exp(- np.square(x - mean) / (2 * var)) / np.sqrt(2 * np.pi *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> var)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> plot_normal_dist(mean, var, rmin=-10, rmax=10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    x </span>= np.arange(rmin, rmax, 0.01<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    y </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> normal_dist(x, mean, var)
    fig </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> plt.plot(x, y)
    
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> plain distribution</span>
lr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LR(n_features)
data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lr.lr(x_test)
mean, var </span>= map(float, [data.mean(), data.std() ** 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
plot_normal_dist(mean, var)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Distribution on plain data:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
plt.show()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> encrypted distribution</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> encrypted_out_distribution(eelr, enc_x_test):
    w </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eelr.weight
    b </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eelr.bias
    data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> enc_x <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> enc_x_test:
        enc_out </span>= enc_x.dot(w) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b
        data.append(enc_out.decrypt())
    data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> torch.tensor(data)
    mean, var </span>= map(float, [data.mean(), data.std() ** 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    plot_normal_dist(mean, var)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Distribution on encrypted data:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    plt.show()

eelr </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncryptedLR(lr)
eelr.encrypt(ctx_training)
encrypted_out_distribution(eelr, enc_x_train)</span></pre>
</div>
<p>明文数据分布：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407161212447-1333323135.png" alt="image" width="361" height="271" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>密文数据分布：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407162119438-1136084639.png" alt="image" width="368" height="277" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>大部分数据属于[-5, 5]，sigmoid近似应该足够好！</p>
<h3>4 基于加密数据的逻辑回归模型</h3>
<p>终于到达了最后一部分，这是关于在加密数据上训练加密逻辑回归模型！你可以看到，我们解密权重，并在每个历元后再次加密它们，这是必要的，因为在历元结束时更新权重后，我们不能再使用它们来执行足够的乘法，所以我们需要将它们恢复到初始密文级别。在真实场景中，这将转化为将权重发送回密钥持有者进行解密和重新加密。在这种情况下，每个轮次只会产生几千字节的通信。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>eelr =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EncryptedLR(LR(n_features))
accuracy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eelr.plain_accuracy(x_test, y_test)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Accuracy at epoch #0 is {accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

times </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> epoch <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(EPOCHS):
    eelr.encrypt(ctx_training)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> if you want to keep an eye on the distribution to make sure</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> the function approximation is still working fine</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> WARNING: this operation is time consuming</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> encrypted_out_distribution(eelr, enc_x_train)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    
    t_start </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> enc_x, enc_y <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> zip(enc_x_train, enc_y_train):
        enc_out </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eelr.forward(enc_x)
        eelr.backward(enc_x, enc_out, enc_y)
    eelr.update_parameters()
    t_end </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> time()
    times.append(t_end </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t_start)
    
    eelr.decrypt()
    accuracy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> eelr.plain_accuracy(x_test, y_test)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Accuracy at epoch #{epoch + 1} is {accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)


</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\nAverage time per epoch: {int(sum(times) / len(times))} seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Final accuracy is {accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

diff_accuracy </span>= plain_accuracy -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accuracy
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Difference between plain and encrypted accuracies: {diff_accuracy}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> diff_accuracy &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 0:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Oh! We got a better accuracy when training on encrypted data! The noise was on our side...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>运行结果：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202604/465567-20260407160615393-1084038271.png" alt="image" width="615" height="172" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>原文中基于加密数据训练的预测精度和基于明文数据训练的预测精度没有精度损失，但是从实际运行结果来看是有精度损失的，暂时不清楚是哪里的原因导致的精度损失。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
